need.current_gap: Current Volvence evidence does not establish that a relationship-condition readout is invariant across surface views or causally connected to the frozen model's next-token decision; same-format accuracy can be a shortcut and a discriminative direction can patch in the wrong sign.
falsification_criteria: Only same-view performance clears while cross-view or weakest-view performance fails, requiring a DOMAIN_LOCAL result.
Same-view separation, causal sign, or matched-random separation fails, requiring INSTRUMENT_INVALID and stopping downstream substrate-authority claims.
A visible public-development PASS does not replicate or depends on one exact layer/view boundary without positive headroom.
protected_boundaries: Evaluation is not a PE or credit learning source.
Praxist may change only structured reader.json fields and may not modify the task, evaluator, corpus, model binding, thresholds, formal protocol, Volvence source, semantic owner, or runtime wiring.
Development PASS does not authorize formal qualification, candidate import, ModificationGate, SHADOW, canary, ACTIVE, or production wiring.
need.required_outcome: Produce exact public-development evidence for linear, difference-of-means, RSA-aligned, future-token-proxy, and random-control readers under a frozen model/corpus/evaluator, with a loop-external formal nomination only if every preregistered gate clears.
success_criteria: At least one complete non-random reader has non-negative minimum normalized qualification margin across every frozen gate.
Same-view and cross-view balanced accuracy, weakest-view accuracy, calibration, held-out Cohen's d, identity retrieval, and direction coherence all clear their preregistered thresholds.
Bounded causal patch improves the signed target-token margin and exceeds the matched random-direction effect by the frozen separation threshold.

objective: Determine whether a bounded residual reader for agency_displacement versus belonging_erasure generalizes across held-out semantic identities, wording, question format, Chinese, role order, and counterfactual form while producing a signed target-logit intervention effect above a matched random direction.
title: Establish cross-view and causal validity of relationship-condition readouts
